canonical_project: ANDA IDC Consortium hyperscale data center (Seongju-dong, Changwon National Industrial Complex)
notes: Hyperscale DC on 44,000 sqm in Changwon National Industrial Complex (Seongsan-gu Seongju-dong); 100,000+ servers; construction started 2024-05-08; power grid impact assessment passed Jan 2026; target completion end-2026.
